data.name: Darrel
data.long_meaning: The Old English name Darrel is derived from two Old English words: ‘dæor’ meaning ‘deer’ and ‘rel’ meaning ‘counsel’ or ‘advice’. Darrel is a name of noble origin, suggesting a free man, a man of counsel, or a man of the deer. It was common among the Anglo-Saxons and the Normans.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the wisdom of nature and the strength of the heart.
data.numerology_meaning: The Life Path Number 5 is an indicative of progress, change, and adventure. People with the name Darrel are free-spirited, curious, and willing to take risks.

in_latin.name: Darrel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen auctoritatis, fortis, et robustus, derivatum a verbo Darrellus, quod significat vir fortis et robustus.
